description: This source file defines the NodePairingApprovalPrompter class responsible for managing node pairing approval prompts within a macOS application. It handles loading pending pairing requests, presenting alerts to users, handling responses, automatic approvals via SSH, and synchronizing pairing requests across multiple instances. The class utilizes various external dependencies for network communication, logging, notifications, and user interface prompts.

classes.name: NodePairingReconcilePolicy
classes.description: Defines configuration parameters and logic for polling and reconciling node pairing requests.

classes.name: NodePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of node pairing approval prompts, including loading requests, presenting alerts, handling responses, and synchronization.

classes.name: PairingList
classes.description: Encapsulates a list of pending pairing requests and paired nodes.

classes.name: PairedNode
classes.description: Represents a node that has been paired, including its metadata.

classes.name: PendingRequest
classes.description: Represents a pending node pairing request with associated metadata and state.

classes.name: SSHTarget
classes.description: Holds SSH target host and port information for silent approval attempts.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the prompter, loading pending requests and beginning reconciliation loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the prompter, cancels ongoing tasks, and resets state.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously loads pending pairing requests from the gateway, with retries.

methods.name: reconcileLoop
methods.description: Periodically reconciles pairing requests to sync state with external sources.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a list of pairing requests and paired nodes, updating internal state and presenting prompts if needed.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events from the gateway related to pairing requests or resolutions.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Presents the next pending pairing request alert if not already presenting.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays an approval prompt for a given pairing request.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles user responses to pairing prompts, including approve or reject actions.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends an approval for a pairing request to the gateway.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects a pairing request via the gateway.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a user notification about pairing resolution outcomes.

methods.name: trySilentApproveIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts silent approval of a pairing request via SSH if conditions are met.

methods.name: resolveSSHTarget
methods.description: Determines SSH target information for silent approval, including auto-discovery.

methods.name: probeSSH
methods.description: Tests SSH connectivity to a host to verify silent approval feasibility.

methods.name: updateReconcileLoop
methods.description: Manages starting or stopping the reconciliation loop based on current state.

methods.name: updatePendingCounts
methods.description: Updates internal counters for pending pairing requests and repairs.

methods.name: reconcileOnce
methods.description: Performs a single reconciliation attempt with the gateway.

methods.name: scheduleReconcileOnce
methods.description: Schedules a reconciliation attempt after a specified delay.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Processes a pairing resolution event, updating state and notifying users.
